cards.title: Gakuran Titles
cards.desc:
## Covers every single in-game title and what do each do

‌

# **General titles:**

## Game creator:

Self explained. This is the MAIN person of the game, the one that had the idea and made it happen, it is only owned by the man himself. Not a huge change between the owner title, mostly a unique title to tell them apart.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_010609.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebba8145ac314d8a498bbb/previews/6aebba8145ac314d8a498c90/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_010609.webp)

‌

## Owner:

self explained. This is the owner of the game, the one that has the final say as to what needs to be added, removed, nerfed and goes on. They got every single perm meaning they can do everything.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235209.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aeba956cb7c92afce6ef130/previews/6aeba956cb7c92afce6ef279/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235209.webp)

## Developer:

Developers are the ones that created the game with the owner, each got their own line such as vfx effects, animations, creating a style, writing the bios, making the map and anything else. Developers are able to give themselves exclusive powers such as goku and make special events like zombie infection or freddy nightmare.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235251.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aeba9a72b0a4fb41c3b3b72/previews/6aeba9a72b0a4fb41c3b3b94/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235251.webp)

## Manager:

Manager is the one that handles the discord server, they create the channels, make sure everything works well, decides a promotion or manages the general sets of what’s allowed and what is not.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235242.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaa20fbc32748ff00f35b/previews/6aebaa21fbc32748ff00f388/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235242.webp)

## Senior staff:

Senior staff works with the manager to handle less important stuff, they handle teams such as the helper team, get to decide any future promotions with the manager, they’re the eyes of the server and a higher staff. The senior staff do not have access to summon any type of events like the developers. They’re simply the main staff that takes care of everyone and also got access to the death note.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235247.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaae10c57c896600839d7/previews/6aebaae10c57c89660083a39/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235247.webp)

## Staff:

Staff are one of the main reasons that the game is safe from exploiters. They fully take care of anything in-game, that includes anything that might break the rules such as weird names, exploits or anyone that might be a threat to the game/not allowed to play. They also take care of the server support tickets and get to decide who gets unbanned. They’re also one of the few people allowed to have a death note.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_000431.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebac06b6c3c5a95336593c/previews/6aebac06b6c3c5a9533659c3/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_000431.webp)

## Trial staff:

Trial staffs are pretty much staff in training that are trying to prove that they can be trusted. They mainly handle small in-server moderation such as warnings, bans, mutes to the people that break the rules in the server, these staff also have small perms in-game such as teleporting or becoming invisible. This is so in case they find any exploiters, which they can later forward it to a staff.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_001446.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebae70d1862514245614ba/previews/6aebae71d18625142456155b/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_001446.webp)

## Contributor:

Contributor are people who have contributed something significant to the game and its development. This can include skateboard art, gamemodes, bots, posters, and more. While initially a more frequently obtainable role in gakuran's early development, it is less likely to be recieved presently.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235300.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebaf1b26437c7d7bb9c8cf/previews/6aebaf1b26437c7d7bb9ca5d/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235300.webp)

## Tester:

Testers are responsible in finding any type of bug before an update happens, they all gather and try everything possible and report it to the developers before the actual release. Their job is to find any major bugs, abuses,  minor bugs, lag issues, quality related bugs and anything that may have an issue or look off in-game. Although there’s too many bugs so not everything minor can be fixed on the update, this doesn’t mean that they do not know it. It simply means that it couldn’t be fixed in time and will be fixed in a different update.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_004717.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb6b54d78b07033e8a32c/previews/6aebb6b54d78b07033e8a757/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_004717.webp)

## QA Lead:

The lead testers, they responsible for making sure that testers do not leak, hand out the titles and get to pick the testers. They manage when everyone should gather and test and make sure that the owner knows any major bug. This is owned by 2 people which both have their own part in the team.

![imag1e.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbce3fbd4df3361d1eeee/previews/6aebbce3fbd4df3361d1f05e/download/imag1e.webp)

## Artist manager:

Artist managers handle the server's artists, they host unique artist events, giveaways, and make sure that each person who posts art follows the art guidelines. They are the ones that decide if you should have the artist role. As reward for their efforts they’re also  allowed to set themselves and only themselves so you may find that each of them have a unique and creative character.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235256.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb0162a6e66338fcfc62c/previews/6aebb0162a6e66338fcfc6d8/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235256.webp)

## Event host:

They’re responsible for any related events, this includes hosting fun events for rewards in the original gakuran server, hosting other events in competitive server, finding ideas, having conversations of what would people like, communicating with each other to make the event as fun as possible and the main part which is to make sure that everything goes smooth without anyone to ruin it. They also the ones that you need to talk to in case you planning to host a server giveaway in the channel.

![image1.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb87eb7d46caea1df2340/previews/6aebb87fb7d46caea1df23ff/download/image1.webp)

## Event manager:

Decides the events, gets to say the final choice before anything happens. The ones that decide who becomes an event host, explains the rules, lists the blacklisted people and manages the entire event team. As a reward for their effort, they also get the ability to set themselves so they can put a character that’d fit the specific event.

![2.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbc6878080be6364df57b/previews/6aebbc6978080be6364df665/download/2.webp)

## Charting manager:

Chart managers are the ones responsible of songs, they make sure what’s get added to rhythm games, manages the charting server and picks people for the chart team. This title is only for one person and only one.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235708.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb0a081f9b6ab6367273c/previews/6aebb0a181f9b6ab6367280f/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235708.webp)

## Song charter:

The song charters create the rhythm-game music and its gameplay, they chart songs, curate the difficulty, making sure every note is tied to the buttons you play in game. Song charters  are really hard working people that put all their effort into making the best possible songs playable and smooth.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235713.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb134f38579eefe881fd9/previews/6aebb135f38579eefe8820ee/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235713.webp)

## Japanify title:

This title is given to the ones that sing, similar to the song charter but instead of rhythm games they sing songs that they made themselves with their own voice which later gets added in-game. The title is one of the only ones that got different variants, the name is based on their original (spotify) name so you can easily search them up and find them for support. There’s also a small case where similar titles for popular singers was handed out that either sound similar or happen to win it. Those 2 are a little different because they did not sing or have an original spotify account, they just a small joke due to them winning a title like that.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235212.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb1a4a3366cf107525be6/previews/6aebb1a5a3366cf107525c65/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235212.webp)

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_011721.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbd08ba75427e2de32487/previews/6aebbd09ba75427e2de3276c/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_011721.webp)

## Trello team:

the ones that made all of this board, the one that’s writing this as you read. Trello team manages the new info right after an update and makes sure everyone is informed, they’re one of the people that know mostly everything, about 20 people own this title and they’re able to answer to all of your questions, feel free to suggest anything if you see them for the Trello. They’re here to make the game easier just for you, just like a helper

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_002143.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb2c488b4b4dfaf5f5cb8/previews/6aebb2c488b4b4dfaf5f5d41/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_002143.webp)

## Trello manager:

Trello manager is the one that handles the whole Trello, they make announcements, put the Trello team in order and they’re one of the ones that fully decide if something is really important for Trello or not. This title is owned by 1 person. They also the ones that get the final choice of who gets to be in the Trello and who gets to write the Trello.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_001451.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb37af87946c0a648bced/previews/6aebb37bf87946c0a648bd96/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_001451.webp)

## University Professor:

Professor title are the staff of the university server. They make sure to have events for content creators, handle server moderation and mainly putting things in order by answering cc related stuff. As a reward for their effort they got a title to show their hard work.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-04\_235306.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb4c091c6fccd11d6c2bd/previews/6aebb4c091c6fccd11d6c374/download/Screenshot_2026-11-04_235306.webp)

## Content creator (cc):

They the ones that make videos in any platform for players to watch, they all got their own different rule and do what they like best, making pvp videos, showing methods, tricks and mainly content for people to enjoy.

![imag2e.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebb945b3e53dcb7c5afd37/previews/6aebb947b3e53dcb7c5b0068/download/imag2e.webp)

## Content creator manager:

The ones that take care of the content creators. They decide who gets to have the role, give the cc sets, makes the rules, decides the events, does fun stuff for the game and also manage the main university server. Only 3 people own it.

![Screenshot\_2026-11-05\_010511.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aebbb58677d3676045d829a/previews/6aebbb58677d3676045d83ae/download/Screenshot_2026-11-05_010511.webp)

## Competitive overseer:

comp overseer is the manager of the competitive side in gakuran. They handle how things should work, checking cheaters and mainly look around the server for any major problems. They’re in charge of anything that has to do with the comp server and anything related to it.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee40387b232c9e66646cbe/previews/6aee40387b232c9e66646deb/download/image.webp)

‌

## Head of lore:

responsible for handling the gakuran “lore” and the manager of the closed community, they take care of anything lore related and they manage/hire the lore team.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee644a9d395d6e1cdc886e/previews/6aee644b9d395d6e1cdc8a93/download/image.webp)

## Lore team:

Responsible for making the lore of gakuran and closed community. They work together to create a small and lovely lore for everyone to enjoy.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aeba6fab6b1985573ca53ec/attachments/6aee6489ee0a9c07a9782baf/previews/6aee6489ee0a9c07a9782cfc/download/image.webp)

cards.title: LIMITED TIME HALLOWEEN EVENT
cards.desc:
## Permanent Candy Shop Overview

The candy shop in part 2 of the halloween event is all permanent items, to get these items you must either spend candies, or rerolls on capsules.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae66b0e633240a0746ed2ae/previews/6ae66b0f633240a0746ed3d3/download/image.webp)

You are able to get limited time faces, uniforms, styles, which can not be rerolled for and are permanent items, you can also get Ofuda which can be traded in for the limited time faces, uniforms and styles.

‌

- **Equipping/Slots:** You can have an option to choose a slot when you roll something, or equip it manually if you scroll down at the candy shop.
- **Toggle Feature:** All current available items such as face/uniforms are able to be toggled on/off at the candy shop with your currently existing items.
- **Post-Update Rule:** It is only after the event they are replacing your current slot. If they're not on you, you won't be able to put them on post-update. Even if you got them during the update.

---

## Ghost Gacha Odds & Pity System

Spend remaining Candy here (100 per single spin / 1000 for 10 spins)

You cannot earn new candy anymore.

- **Jackpot (0.2%):** Limited Styles (2 available: `jason` & `scarecrow`).
  - _Guaranteed Pity:_ You are guaranteed a jackpot by turn 350 at the latest.
- **Big Win (1.5%):** Halloween Faces (5 available: `red`, `blud`, `doll`, `bow`, `spider`).
- **Win (5.0%):** Halloween Fits (6 variations available).
- **Miss (93.3%):** +0 Ofuda (Base roll).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae682e6f84521a7944f0252/previews/6ae682e7f84521a7944f03b0/download/image.webp)

### **General Gacha Rules:**

- **No Dupes:** There are no duplicate drops. If you already own everything in a category, you will receive Ofuda instead.
- **Ofuda Income:** Every turn gives 1 Ofuda.
- **Daily Limit:** Maximum of 200 reroll turns allowed per day.
- **Deadline:** The entire Candy Shop and Gacha event closes in **7 days and.**
  \* Limited styles cannot be rerolled for, after the shop closes.

![1x.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ad3d8c8b10a098039ce672b/attachments/6ae68277dc4fa4ed5e8e9b64/download/1x.gif)

---

## Ofuda Trade-In Shop

If you don't unlock the limited items via Gacha rolls, you can trade your accumulated Ofuda directly at the shop:

- **Limited Style:** 1200 Ofuda
- **Halloween Face:** 250 Ofuda
- **Halloween Uniform:** 80 Ofuda

cards.title: How To Play
cards.desc:
## **Before Joining the Game:**

Before joining the game, ensure that your Roblox account:

- Is verified as 16+
- Is in the [Roblox Group](https://www.roblox.com/communities/416091513/Gakuran#!/about "‌")

After you meet the previously listed requirements, you can join the game.

## **Once You Are in the Game:**

### Character Customization:

#### Gender:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50924c65a8578d5e50b189/attachments/6a50992c1500c26bd20a6183/previews/6a50992c1500c26bd20a61b0/download/image.webp)

Once you join, you will be greeted with a character creation screen. First, you must choose your gender: male or female. Please note that:

- **Gender affects height** (with males having a significantly higher average height then female)
- **Both genders have varying accessory pools**
- **Gender can be changed in the stat menu**

With that in mind, you can select a gender.

#### Name:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a50924c65a8578d5e50b189/attachments/6a5099665cc68c87034707a9/previews/6a5099675cc68c87034707e0/download/image.webp)

After you select a gender, you must choose a name. Note that: last names are randomized and you do not get to choose it; however, you can change it via rolling. Furthermore, ensure that your name is not derogatory or breaks Roblox ToS. **If you get the error:**

> “Server Rejected Data”

It means:

- Your name was tagged by Roblox
- It broke one of the name rules

And you need to choose a different name.

### In the Game:

Once you are in the game your ethnicity, height, last name, accessories, hair, hair color, face are all randomized. You can now enjoy the game!

cards.title: Controls
cards.desc:
# **PC:**

Move: W / A / S / D
Sprint: Hold Shift
Turn Camera: Move Mouse
Free Cam: Shift + P
Light Attack (M1): Left Click
Heavy Attack (M2): R
Block: Hold F
Parry: Click F
Dash: Q
Interact: E
Open Phone: Left Alt
Equip Fighting Style: T
Carry Downed Player: V
Execute/Grip Downed Player: B
Drop/Place Item: Backspace
Jump: Space
Shift-Lock: Ctrl
Open Emote Wheel: G
Swap POV: Tab

---

**Universal Chat commands:**

**/Me** : followed by a message, starts and ends your message with an asterisk (*_). Additionally_ **using an asterisk** before and after a message highlights the message in pink.

**/S** : followed by a message, makes a shouted/emphasized version of your message.

/**ooc** : followed by a message, makes the message appear cleanly with no effects or speaking lines.

**/w** : followed by a message, makes the message appear in italics and light gray text. The chat can only be read by people within 3m of the speaker, otherwise it appears as \*unintelligible\*.

**Mb / Mb all** : Clears _IN COMBAT_ status at the top of your screen. There are different conditions for this chat command to work. (Bow emote does this as well)

**If only you** attack someone and they didn’t hit back, only you have to say _Mb or Mb all_. **If another player** : attacks you by accident, they must say _Mb or Mb all_ to exit early **If both of you** : attack each other and then decide not to, both players must say it to leave /forgive combat early.

---

# **Console:**

Move: Left Stick
Sprint: Hold Left Trigger (LT / L2)
Turn Camera: Right Stick
Light Attack (M1): Right Trigger (RT / R2)
Heavy Attack (M2): Right Bumper (RB / R1)
Block: X Button / Square Button
Dash: B Button / Circle Button
Interact: X Button / Square Button
Open Phone: D-Pad Right
Equip Fighting Style: Left Bumper (LB / L1)
Carry Downed Player: D-Pad Up
Execute/Grip Downed Player: D-Pad Down
Drop/Place Item: D-Pad Up
Jump: A Button / Cross Button
Shift-Lock: Press Left Stick (L3)
Open Emote Wheel: D-Pad Left
Swap POV: Y Button / Triangle Button

cards.title: How to Report
cards.desc:
To report people who broke the rules in Gakuran, first ensure that they broke one of the following rules:

> - Explicit Drawings
> - Permanent Trapping Players
> - Prolonged Carrying of Other Players
> - Infinite Holding
> - Throwing individuals into the void
> - Bug Abuse
> - Exploiting
> - Extreme Harassment
> - Exploiter Affiliation

Please note that: W+Sing is no longer bannable, unless it is an intentionally sexual act and not an act of toxicity.

When you report a player, you need three things. The first two, come in the form of a clip (short video recorded capturing the rule break). Within the clip, **ensure that it clearly captures the rule break occur with the person's name, and that you then open the left player list and show their name as it corresponds to their username.**

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a55591a629547648456a198/attachments/6a555bd0a34be7b841e385bd/previews/6a555bd1a34be7b841e385da/download/image.webp)

The third thing that is necessary for a proper report, is **that the clip is uploaded somewhere. When reporting, it requires you submit a link as evidence**; so, ensure that you have one.

After that, please make sure that you are in the [Gakuran Support Server](https://discord.com/channels/1439650635011330138/1505497147934773399/1525884738710143029 "‌") and fill out the required fields in the report embed. For the use “Username” field, make sure **it's the person BEING reported**, not YOU.

cards.title: PS+ Guide
cards.desc:
To open the PS+ Command panel, open the left menu and select “Commands.”

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaef9ee93ad8c3a9b6c0ef9/previews/6aaef9ef93ad8c3a9b6c1165/download/image.webp)

### Server Commands:

Once the command panel is open, you are greeted by a few miscellaneous server options. First, are the weather and time of day, which can be controlled via slider and buttons.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa07558cd9e95e69fa44/previews/6aaefa07558cd9e95e69fcc1/download/image.webp)

On the second half of the miscellaneous server options, you are able to do two types of announcements: Proximity and Server. Server announcements send messages to the entire server, while proximity announcements send messages to those around (via a controlled radius). More specifically, it will send messages to people that are within a given distance around you. The unit of measurement used is studs.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa164a88cccc625e44a3/previews/6aaefa164a88cccc625e4731/download/image.webp)

Lastly, there are a few global commands that are self-explanatory:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa22f88851f07a273dd4/previews/6aaefa22f88851f07a2740a3/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa294f874e6f20f0b4e6/previews/6aaefa2a4f874e6f20f0b809/download/image.webp)

### Individual player commands:

Next, is the “PLAYERS” tab, which allows for commands that can be used on singular persons.

The first tab is self-explanatory; it allows you to ban players for a determined duration:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa34458fd28255321602/previews/6aaefa35458fd282553219cf/download/image.webp)

At the top of the "PLAYERS" tab, you can search and scroll through any active members within your server.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa3b8f99d82e05287e54/previews/6aaefa3b8f99d82e0528813f/download/image.webp)

You can also unban any banned players:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa41460a2a99d1c2f53e/previews/6aaefa42460a2a99d1c2fb02/download/image.webp)

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa4d6720f8fbbde702f7/previews/6aaefa4e6720f8fbbde705e0/download/image.webp)

By clicking on a player, you can run a multitude of commands on them, including:

**Actions:**

- Bring
- Go To
- Respawn
- Heal
- Kick
  **Role:**
- Set Role (Choose between all available roles created)
- Panel Access (Grants Admin)
  **State**:
- Godmode
- Freeze
- Invisible
- Fly
  **Sight:**
- ESP
- See other health bars
- Freecam range (5-5000)
  **Movement:**
- Walk speed (4-60)
- Reset Walk Speed
  **Ban:**
- Duration (Forever, 1-365 days)

### NPC Commands:

Under the “NPC” tab, you can spawn various NPCs with different purposes (including ones with AI). First, you can spawn a basic NPC that will sit in the seat nearest to you.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa53303c7dc9acaf4431/previews/6aaefa54303c7dc9acaf4832/download/image.webp)

The second command allows you to spawn 1-50 NPCs that will all sit at the nearest free seat (relative to you).

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefa9adda18707fa0717b3/previews/6aaefa9adda18707fa071b1a/download/image.webp)

The third command with spawn 1-120 NPC’s Infront of you in a crowd.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbee5cea27da300ca2f5/previews/6aaefbee5cea27da300ca64e/download/image.webp)

The fourth command will allow you to spawn NPCs on instruments; they will perform with you. For drummer and keyboard NPC’s they need a free instrument, the other type of performers will spawn with their instrument.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbf429277bdafaebfcc9/previews/6aaefbf629277bdafaec0307/download/image.webp)

The fifth command will spawn an Ally Squad of NPCs that will follow behind you. They can will also fight alongside you. You can command them with: “/s follow” and “/s attack”. You can also give them specific clothing.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6aaefbfa6c10d88e85403b7a/previews/6aaefbfb6c10d88e85403ebd/download/image.webp)

‌

#### **How do games work:**


in the private, there's a new section called "modes" pressing it will give you 6 choices, pressing each mode button will make a small message appear of how everything works.

![modes.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a51b017fb73a103f24b5ac3/attachments/6ada7ecfd6be0da92e3d46f5/previews/6ada7ed0d6be0da92e3d4b4c/download/modes.webp)

‌

#### Gang War

Two gangs fight with respawns enabled. Knocking an enemy down gives 1 point, while gripping them gives 2. The first gang to reach the score limit wins, or the gang with the most points when time runs out. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Otherwise, they bleed out after 20 seconds and respawn at base.

#### Turf War

Three zones are placed across the map: A near one base, B in the middle, and C near the other base. Stand in a zone without enemies to capture it, with teammates making the process faster. Held zones give 1 point per second, while capturing a zone, knocking an enemy down, or finishing them off gives 5 points. Capturing a zone costs the leading side 20 points. Once the score limit is reached, the losing side enters the breaking phase, where downed players can no longer respawn.

#### Raid

One side attacks the school while the other defends it. Raiders must escort a truck to the front gate. It only moves when a raider is nearby and no defenders are close. The truck is destroyed after taking 60 hits. Once the gate falls, raiders push into the courtyard and fight the remaining defenders, including the Banchou, who has extra health and cannot respawn in the final phase. Raiders share a limited respawn pool. Defenders win if the truck is destroyed, the respawns run out, or time expires.

#### Last Gang Standing

A team-based mode with no respawns. Teammates can revive downed players by holding the button. Getting gripped or bleeding out after 20 seconds eliminates you for the rest of the round. The side with the last player standing wins, or the side with more survivors when time runs out. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match.

#### Taiman

A 1v1 or 2v2 fight that starts where the players are, with a crowd watching nearby. There are no respawns, and the last side standing wins the round. The side that wins the most rounds takes the match. Both sides must have the same number of players to start.

#### Hatatori

Three flags are placed around the map. Hold the button to pick one up, then bring it to your side's shrine to secure it. Enemies can steal secured flags, and getting knocked down makes you drop the flag you're carrying. Dropped flags return to their starting spot after 30 seconds. Hold all three flags for the required time to win, or have the most secured flags when time runs out.

cards.title: Height Based Combat Modifiers
cards.desc:
##### Your characters height determines your hitbox size, attack speed and damage.

##### _Taller = **more** damage, **more** health, **larger** hitbox, **slower** attacks._

##### Shorter = **less** damage, **less** health, **smaller** hitbox, **faster** attacks.

---

## Technical buffs/debuffs

## Short vs. Tall Height Comparison

**📏 Minimum Height**

- **M1 Reach:** 5.10
- **M2 Reach:** 4.25
- **Damage:** 0.85x
- **Atk Speed:** 1.15x
- **M1 Width:** 3.40
- **Max HP:** 85
- **Heavy CD:**  CD / 1.15

**📐 Maximum Height**

- **M1 Reach:** 6.90
- **M2 Reach:** 5.75
- **Damage:** 1.15x
- **Atk Speed:** 0.95x
- **M1 Width:** 4.60
- **Max HP:** 115
- **Heavy CD:** CD / .85

The main advantage of **Height** is the box face growing — you get **much more lateral and vertical hitbox** than with Reach, plus a slight reach increase on top.

---

### Attack Speed

_Taller = **slower** swings, Shorter = **faster** swings_

- this includes combo reset timers, meaning shorter players attacking cooldowns are shorter.

### Damage

Taller = **more** damage, Shorter = **less** damage

- stacks with style damage.

### Hitbox Size

Taller = **larger** attack hitboxes, Shorter = **smaller** attack hitboxes

- easier to land hits when taller, can play ranged/distance playstyle

### Health

Taller = **more** health, Shorter = **less** health

- Not a _major difference or change in health unless extremely_ tall or _extremely_ short (base health = 100HP)

cards.title: Posture / Stamina
cards.desc:
**Posture = Stamina** | Movement uses it for sprinting (how long you can run) , combat uses it for blocking (how many attacks can be blocked before you are guardbroken), in addition Sprinting & Blocking hits both drain posture.

- **Posture:**
  Prevents passive play, **blocking** an attack will take your **posture** instead of your HP (not including chip damage). A non displayed meter, if **depleted** will not allow the user to block the next attack. Getting hit with depleted posture will trigger a “**Guard break**” which stuns the defender giving the opponent an opening to attack.
- **Stamina:**
  To prevent infinite running just like posture it is an non displayed meter, when **depleted** will not allow the user to sprint.
  **Posture is NOT needed to perfect block (parry)**

---

**Combat style perks that affect posture:**

`Crushing Force I` : +10% posture damage on every hit. ([Kickboxing](https://trello.com/c/wTEq8I8q/218-kickboxing "‌"))

‌

- Swift Recovery: +15% posture regen. ([Basic](https://trello.com/c/JGzGNMSq "‌"))

‌

- Steady Nerves: +25% posture regen for 3s after a parry ([Karate](https://trello.com/c/vvwaQffG "‌"))

‌

cards.desc:
Every combat style has a ‘Block Chip Percentage’ via the `Guard Pierce` perk.

- This controls how much damage your attack does on somebody that blocked the attack.
- There is **NO DAMAGE** done if the attack is parried.

For example, if my style has `Guard Pierce I: 10% block chip damage`, a blocked attack that normally does `5 DMG` will only do `0.5 DMG`. However, If I had a style with `Guard Pierce IV: 25% block chip damage`, then it would do `1.25 DMG` instead.

cards.title: Parrying / Perfect Blocking
cards.desc:
_Parrying_ is a timed block right as an attack is about to land. If your timing is inside the **parry window** while facing the attacker, you **perfect block** instead of taking a normal block.

- A parry is **not** a normal block: **no damage, no block chip, no posture loss.**
- **Parrying** _stuns_ your attacker temporarily for **0.45 seconds**, presenting the opportunity to counter and attack them.

**Combat Style Perks** that reward parrying:

cards.title: Hyper-armor / IFrames
cards.desc:
**Hyper-Armor** is when your attack absorbs a hit without flinching. You still take full damage, but your swing cannot be interrupted and plays out to completion.

- **Hyper-Armor does not stop damage.** You eat the hit, but you keep swinging.
- `M2s` are the only armored attacks currently, active from startup until the hit lands.
- **Hyper-Armor** is limited to certain styles.

**The combat style perks that include hyper-armor:**

- ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6a5105dbc5e9daa0207fc730/attachments/6ae89811dbcd250f355b59d1/previews/6ae89811dbcd250f355b59e8/download/image.webp)

---

**IFrames** are a brief window where your character is completely unhittable. Attacks pass through you dealing no damage, no chip, and no hitstun the hit simply whiffs.

- **Nothing connects during i-frames.** Unlike hyper armor, you take zero damage, not full damage.
- `Dodges` are the main i-frame moves, active only during the animation's startup and travel you are vulnerable again on recovery.
- I-frames avoid strikes, but **do not** save you from `clashing`.
- Getting hit on recovery (after the window ends) is a full punish, a whiffed dodge is worse than blocking.
- You are an additional **iframe dodge** when fighting more than 1 opponent.

**Combat style perks which include Iframes:**

- **Untouchable**
  M2ing throws a two-punch combo with **IFrames** for the whole animation. Each punch is its own attack. You can eat the first and parry the second. ([Boxing](https://trello.com/c/9zucAqBC "‌"))
- Float Like a Butterfly
  The crit shuffle grants **IFrames** for its entire windup, Shuffle straight through anything thrown at you. ([Ali](https://trello.com/c/Roh6sIpv/168-ali "‌"))
